dependencies.reason: uses the hub client with Available and its typed error, the fake hub, the API server's Handle, the client's Register, the store's migrations and the e2e helper
uses command.Runner, gitclone.Sync, the clones directory and the hub client's Workspace
moves items with Transition, Abandon and CreateLinked, registers with OnChange and OnAbandon, and declares the decision kind `plan` in the inbox's registry
registers its step functions with the scheduler and runs planner and reviewer sessions through RunSession

tasks.title: Create the item's task fork, open its draft change and abandon it
steps: Extend internal/hubtest: `POST /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/forks` (the name's format, `409 conflict` for a name the parent has, a scriptable error, the fork sharing its parent's repository and served at a git endpoint of its own, reusing what package 04 added for a seeded fork), `GET …/scm/refs/{name}` answering from the repository with `404 ref_not_found`, `POST …/changes` (draft changes, `400 source_not_found` for a branch the fork lacks, `409 change_exists` with details), `POST …/changes/{number}/abandon` (`409 change_closed`), and accessors Fork, Ref, Change and Changes for tests

Add the change behaviours to internal/change/change_test.go and confirm they fail; keep the fixtures (a change service over a copy of the store template of internal/store with a real item service and inbox, the fake hub with the workspace `demo`) in internal/change/helpers_test.go, the one helpers file of the package

Add to the hub client of internal/hub, each sent with the worker credential and returning Parley's error envelope as the typed error package 01 defines: CreateFork(ctx, parent, name, purpose) sending auto_change false, Ref(ctx, slug, name), OpenChange(ctx, slug, request) and AbandonChange(ctx, slug, number, reason); cover the request bodies in internal/hub/client_test.go

Add internal/change with a store migration registered with internal/store: per item the workspace, the generation, and for the current generation the fork's slug, its git URL, the branch, the change's number and its ref; construct the service with change.New over the store, the hub client, the item service and the inbox, with no package-level state

Add EnsureFork: return the stored record without a request; otherwise refuse with ErrHubUnavailable while Available of the worker credential is false, create the fork `i<N>` (or `i<N>-<g>` from generation 2 on) with the purpose `nightshift item <N>: <title>` cut to 1,024 characters, take a `409 conflict` as the item's own fork by reading its workspace object with the hub client's Workspace, store the record and write the `fork_created` entry through the inbox's Append without the unread mark

Add Get (ErrNotFound for an item with no fork), Head (the branch's sha, ErrNoBranch for `404 ref_not_found`) and Forget (drop the fork and the change of the current generation, keep the generation, send nothing)

Add OpenDraft: return the stored record when the item has a change; otherwise open the change as a draft from the fork's branch into the workspace with the title cut to 200 characters, the intent cut to 16,000 and the session id where one is given, take a `409 change_exists` as the item's own change from its details, store the number and the ref, build ChangeURL from the hub's endpoint, and write the `change_opened` entry
Add Abandon: nothing to do and nil for an item with no fork or no change; otherwise abandon the change with the reason, treat `409 change_closed` as done, and write the `change_abandoned` entry
Return the hub client's error unchanged from all four for any other answer, store nothing and write no entry in that case

Create the change service in daemon.Run after the item service and register its Abandon with the item service's OnAbandon under the name `change`, after the hook of package 04, so that an item's sessions are ended before its change is abandoned; hand the service to the end-to-end helper of internal/daemon/e2e_test.go

Name the fake hub's fork, ref and change routes under Repository Specifics in .specs/steering.md, and add internal/change to docs/architecture.md with what later packages call: EnsureFork, OpenDraft, Head, Get, Abandon, Forget and the names of the fork and the branch

tasks.title: Start the planning of an item and give it its package number
steps: Add the start behaviours to internal/plan/start_test.go, the route behaviours to internal/plan/routes_test.go, the number behaviours to internal/plan/number_test.go and the command's rows to internal/cli/item_test.go and confirm they fail; keep the fixtures (a plan service over a copy of the store template with a real item service, inbox and change service, a fake scheduler that records the requests of RunSession and returns scripted results, the fake hub, a stub for the default branch's tree) in internal/plan/helpers_test.go, the one helpers file of the package

Add internal/plan with a store migration registered with internal/store: one plan per item holding whether it was asked for, whether `no_plan_approval` was given, the package number, the package's directory, the accepted head, the phase (`draft`, `review`, `revise` or `ended`), the round, the verdict, the findings with their replies, the pending findings of the person, the split parts, the open decision's id, a stored answer and further evidence; later tasks fill the members they own

Construct the service with plan.New over the store, the item service, the inbox, the change service, the hub client, a session runner (the RunSession of package 04's Scheduler, an interface here), a command.Runner, the clones directory and the number of rounds (default 3); keep no package-level state, and expose Get(ctx, item) returning the plan as a value for tests and later packages

Add StepNew, the step function of the state `new`: a `spec` item moves to `ready` with the reason `imported package`; a `defect` or `change_request` whose source type is not `item`, or whose plan was asked for, moves to `planning` with the reason `planning started`; any other item is left as it is, with nil returned

Add Request(ctx, item, noPlanApproval) with the refusals ErrNotFound, a conflict naming the state for an item that is not `new`, and a conflict for a `spec` item; it stores that the plan was asked for and sets `no_plan_approval` when true, never back to false; add NeedsApproval(ctx, item): the item's `plan_approval` and not the stored option

Register `POST /api/v1/items/{number}/plan` through the API server's Handle: decode the optional body refusing a non-object, an unknown member and a non-boolean with 400 invalid_request, map the refusals to 404 not_found and 409 conflict with their messages through the error helper, and answer 200 with the item as package 03's routes serialise it

Add the command `nightshift item plan <N> [--no-plan-approval]` to the item commands package 03 registered in internal/cli: the flag accepted before and after the number, the usage errors with exit code 2 before any request, `planning item <N>` on stdout or the item's JSON with --json

Add Number(ctx, item): return the stored number; otherwise, under one lock per workspace, read the `head_sha` of the workspace with the hub client's Workspace, bring the item's clone `<clones directory>/<fork slug>.plan` to it with gitclone.Sync (the fork's git URL from the change service, the worker token, the Runner), list `.specs` and `.specs/archive` with afspec.ListSpecDirs and take the highest prefix through ParseSpecDirName, a missing directory counting as none; take the highest number stored for another item of the workspace that is neither `done` nor `abandoned`; store one above the greater of the two in the same transaction that read the others; format it with two digits, three from 100 on
Make the reading of the default branch's tree a function the service is constructed with, so that the number tests replace it with a directory

Create the plan service in daemon.Run after the scheduler and the change service, and register StepNew with Scheduler.RegisterStep for `new`; give the end-to-end helper of internal/daemon/e2e_test.go a switch that starts the daemon without this package's steps, and set it in the flows of packages 03 and 04 that create or seed items without planning them
Describe the route with its refusals in docs/api.md and the command in docs/cli.md, and add internal/plan with the three states it drives and the rule for the package number to docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: Run the planner, accept its package from the fork and keep its text
steps: Add the planner behaviours to internal/plan/planner_test.go and the acceptance behaviours to internal/plan/accept_test.go and confirm they fail; build the fixture packages through afspec itself (CreateSpec, the artefacts filled, Save) once per test process and copy them per test: a valid draft `greeting`, one with a validation warning, one whose task names an unknown criterion, one without a `## Intent` section; let the fake scheduler run a scripted function as the session, which may push to the fake hub's fork, calls the Spec's Accept with the scripted result, and returns `completed`, or `failed` with the first line of Accept's error

Add StepPlanning, the step function of the state `planning`, and register it with Scheduler.RegisterStep; it does one thing per call and returns, so that the scheduler calls it again: ensure the fork, give the number, then act on the plan's phase; the phase of a new plan is `draft`

At the phase `draft`, first look at the fork: when Head finds the branch and the package with the item's number is there and passes the acceptance, take it as accepted without a session; otherwise ask RunSession for the planner session with the step name `plan`, the branch `item-<N>`, the input `text` and the prompt with `--number`, ` --defect` for a defect, and no class
Build the item's text from its source: the stored text, or for an issue the title, the body and each comment under `## Comment by <author>`

Add the acceptance function given as the Spec's Accept: parse the result document, refuse a missing outcome and any outcome but `written` with its reason, read the branch's head with the change service's Head, bring the `.plan` clone to it with gitclone.Sync, find the directory under `.specs` whose prefix equals the number as a number, load it with afspec.LoadSpec and validate it with ValidateInRoot over `.specs` of the clone; return the reasons of the criterion as errors and ignore warnings

After a `completed` result, in one store transaction: record the directory, the head and the phase `review`, and store the kept text, every regular file under the package's directory read from the clone, with the number, the directory and the head; then write the `plan_written` entry

Create the split parts from `remaining_scopes` of the result with the item service's CreateLinked, in the order listed, of the item's kind, with the scope's text or its summary, skipping a name the plan already holds, and record each new item's number with the name

Open the draft change with the change service's OpenDraft when the item has none: the item's title, the `## Intent` section of the package's PRD body without its heading, and the session's id (empty for a package taken without a session)
Return from the step without changing the plan for a result that is not `completed` and for sched.ErrNotStarted, and return the context's error for a cancelled context

Add Kept(ctx, item), returning the text stored last or ErrNotFound, and register with the item service's OnChange a hook that, when an item becomes `done` or `abandoned`, deletes every kept text and the plan's clone directory `<clones directory>/<fork slug>.plan`, the latter through the Runner so that it works for a clone the session user owns
Add to docs/architecture.md the planner's prompt, the acceptance order with its reasons, the kept text with Kept, and the clone nightshift reads the fork through

tasks.title: Have every plan reviewed, for up to three rounds
steps: Add the review behaviours to internal/plan/review_test.go and confirm they fail

At the phase `review`, ask RunSession for a reviewer session with the step name `plan_review`, the fork and the accepted head as the commit; build its prompt, the review brief, from the item's text, the package's directory, the verdict object package 04 requires (`{"verdict": "agree" | "object", "findings": [{"text", "file"?, "line"?, "criterion"?}]}`) and, where the plan has findings of earlier reviews, each with its id, its text and its reply; give it no inputs and no Accept

On the verdict `agree`: add one to the round, store the verdict and write the `plan_review` entry `reviewer: agree`; with no pending finding of the person set the phase `ended`, otherwise set the phase `revise` with no reviewer finding

On the verdict `object`: add one to the round, replace the plan's findings by the verdict's with the ids `r<round>.<n>`, store the verdict, write the entry `reviewer: object, <n> findings` and set the phase `revise`

At the phase `revise`, ask for a planner session with the step name `plan`, the branch, the input `findings` (the JSON array: the plan's reviewer findings as `{id, source: "review", text, criterion?}`, then the pending findings of the person as `{id, source: "person", text}`) and the prompt with `--findings` and the package's directory, with the acceptance function of the planner run

After a `completed` revision: keep the text as after a first result, store each reply of `replies` with the finding of its id and `no reply` for a finding without one, mark the findings of the person it carried as delivered, create split parts for scope names not seen before, and set the phase `review`, or `ended` when the verdict is `object` and the round has reached the number of rounds
Add AddFinding(ctx, item, text) with its refusals ErrInvalid and ErrNotPlanning; a finding of the person gets the next id `p<n>` of the item and stays pending until a revision carried it
Describe the rounds, the findings file, the ids and AddFinding in docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: Ask the person with the plan decision and activate an approved package
steps: Add the decision behaviours to internal/plan/decision_test.go and the activation behaviours to internal/plan/activate_test.go and internal/daemon/start_test.go and confirm they fail; extend internal/hubtest with `POST …/policy/evaluate` answering a scripted list of requirements or a scripted error and recording the paths; add a TestMain to internal/plan that calls plan.ActivateMain when the test binary's first argument is `activate-package`

Declare the decision kind `plan` with the inbox's RegisterKind while daemon.Run wires the packages: `approve` (`activates the package and makes the item ready`), `revise` (`sends the plan back to the planner with your comment`, comment required) and `abandon` (`ends the item without landing`); register with OnAnswer one handler per option that stores the option and the comment with the plan, once, and returns nil
At the phase `ended` in StepPlanning, for a plan that needs an approval or whose verdict is `object`, move the item to `awaiting_approval` with the reason `plan ready for approval`
Add StepAwaiting, the step function of the state `awaiting_approval`, and register it: with a stored answer, carry it out; with no open decision recorded, open one; otherwise return nil

Add EvaluatePaths(ctx, slug, paths) to the hub client with the worker credential, and build the decision's evidence in the order of the criterion: the render of the package loaded from the `.plan` clone at the accepted head (from the kept text written to a temporary directory when the fork is gone), the change's URL, the distinct `touches`, the `policy` entries from EvaluatePaths over those paths, the verdict, the open findings of a plan that ended as objected, the split parts with their titles from the item service, and any further evidence the plan holds

Open the decision with the inbox's Open on the item's thread, `approve` recommended for the verdict `agree` and `revise` otherwise, and record its id with the plan in the same call; an error of the evaluation returns from the step before anything is opened
Add RegisterPrepare(name, fn) and call the functions in order before `approve` and `revise` are carried out; return `prepare <name>: <error>` for the first that fails and leave the answer stored

Add plan.ActivateMain(args, stderr): load the package with afspec.LoadSpec, call Transition to `active` on its directory, print `activate-package: <error>` and return 1 on an error, the usage and 2 for wrong arguments; have daemon.Run call it when its first argument is `activate-package`, before it reads a configuration

Add the activation: bring the `.plan` clone to the branch's head; when the package there is a draft, run the executable with `activate-package <directory>` in the clone through the Runner, then `git add` of the package's directory, a commit with the message `chore: activate package <NN_name>` and the author and committer `nightshift <nightshift@localhost>` given through the environment, and a push of HEAD to `refs/heads/item-<N>` of the fork's git URL with the worker token in an `http.extraHeader` given through GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, as internal/gitclone gives it; a package that is active already skips all of it

Carry out `approve` (activation, the `plan_approved` entry, the move to `ready` with `plan approved`), `revise` (through Revise: the comment as a pending finding of the person, the round zero, the phase `revise`, the reviewer findings cleared, the move to `planning` with `plan sent back`) and `abandon` (the item service's Abandon with `plan abandoned`); clear the stored answer and the decision's id when it was carried out

When the activation command exits other than 0, write the `activation_failed` entry, add the evidence `activation failed` with the last 50 lines of its output to the plan, move the item to `awaiting_approval` where it is not there, and let the next call open a new decision with `revise` recommended; return a failed push or hub request as the step's error without opening anything
Describe the kind `plan`, its options and its evidence in docs/api.md, the `activate-package` mode in docs/cli.md, and RegisterPrepare, Revise and the activation in docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: Go on without an approval, re-open a plan decision and survive a restart
steps: Add the behaviours to internal/plan/plan_test.go and confirm they fail

At the phase `ended` in StepPlanning, for a plan with the verdict `agree` that needs no approval: activate the package as an approval does, write the `plan_approved` entry `plan approved at creation: <the change's URL>` and move the item to `ready` with the reason `plan approved at creation`, opening no decision

Add Reopen(ctx, item, reason, extra): refuse an item with no kept text with ErrNotFound, move the item to `awaiting_approval` through the item service's Transition with the reason and return its error unchanged, store `extra` as the plan's further evidence, clear the recorded decision and mark the plan as needing a decision with `revise` recommended, so that StepAwaiting opens it
Have both StepPlanning and StepAwaiting return nil at once, before any request or session, while Available of the hub client is false for the worker credential

Make every write of a plan one store transaction that holds the phase and what belongs to it, so that a daemon that stops between two steps continues from the stored phase; cover each stopping point with the table of the restart check, a store file opened by two services

Add the three flows to internal/daemon/e2e_test.go with a fake `claude` script that writes, revises, commits and pushes a fixture package and writes the result file its prompt names, recording its prompts and findings files, and a provider/faux reviewer scripted per flow

Update README.md with how a defect or a change request is planned and approved and what `--no-plan-approval` does; complete docs/architecture.md with the path of an item from `new` to `ready` and with Reopen; state in docs/configuration.md that this package adds no key; run `make doc`
done_when: `make check` passes on the whole tree
